done.title: Payment proof sent
done.body: The school will confirm it soon. Your bills show Waiting for confirmation until then.

bkash.exactNote: You pay exactly {{amount}}. No extra charge.

result.title: Payment result
result.loadError: Could not load the payment result. Check your connection and try again.
result.paidBody: The money reached the school. Your bills are now paid.
result.printError: Could not open the receipt. Allow pop-ups and try again.
result.unmatched: Some bills were already paid, so the rest of the money went to your wallet. The school will adjust it for you.
